unpublishedAction.name: CreateApplication

actionConfiguration.body:
{{
{
  external_id:
    "appsmith-v4-" +
    inpAppName.text
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, ""),

  name: inpAppName.text.trim(),
  platform: "appsmith",

  owner_name: inpOwnerName.text.trim(),
  owner_email: inpOwnerEmail.text.trim(),
  business_unit: inpBusinessUnit.text.trim(),
  business_purpose: inpBusinessPurpose.text.trim(),

  registration_status: "registered",
  lifecycle_status: "active",

  data_classification:
    selDataClassification.selectedOptionValue,

  internet_exposed:
    selInternetExposed.selectedOptionValue === "true",

  external_integration:
    selExternalIntegrations.selectedOptionValue === "true",

  integration_approved:
    selIntegrationApproved.selectedOptionValue === "true",

  credential_type:
    selCredentialType.selectedOptionValue || null,

  data_fields:
    inpDataFields.text.trim(),

  connector_metadata:
    inpConnectorMetadata.text.trim()
}
}}
